note: Outside data: BIP-32's published test vectors 1, 2 and 3 (https://github.com/bitcoin/bips/blob/master/bip-0032.mediawiki), each master seed with its first published child (m/0H, m/0, m/0H). The child's parent-fingerprint field is the master key's fingerprint; base58check guards each string. Read by test/keystore-index.test.js and clients/ua-rs/tests/index_mac.rs.
